license_required.quote: No person shall engage in the practice of dentistry in this State, or offer or attempt to do so, unless such person is the holder of a valid license or certificate of renewal of license duly issued by the North Carolina State Board of Dental Examiners.

issuing_authority.value: North Carolina State Board of Dental Examiners
issuing_authority.quote: the North Carolina State Board of Dental Examiners heretofore created by Chapter 139, Public Laws 1879 and by Chapter 178, Public Laws 1915, is hereby continued as the agency of the State for the regulation of the practice of dentistry in this State

name.value: North Carolina State Board of Dental Examiners
name.quote: the North Carolina State Board of Dental Examiners heretofore created by Chapter 139, Public Laws 1879 and by Chapter 178, Public Laws 1915, is hereby continued as the agency of the State for the regulation of the practice of dentistry in this State

type.quote: Said Board of Dental Examiners shall consist of six dentists who are licensed to practice dentistry in North Carolina, one dental hygienist who is licensed to practice dental hygiene in North Carolina and one person who shall be a citizen and resident of North Carolina

age_minimum.quote: The applicant for a license to practice dentistry shall be of good moral character, at least 18 years of age at the time the application is filed.

moral_character_required.quote: The applicant for a license to practice dentistry shall be of good moral character

degree_required.value: DDS or DMD from an accredited dental school
degree_required.quote: that the applicant is a graduate of and has a diploma from a reputable dental college or the dental department of a reputable university or college recognized, accredited and approved as such by the Board

accrediting_body.value: Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association
accrediting_body.quote: a DDS or DMD degree from a program of dentistry in a school or college accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association and approved by the Board

exams.name: Board-approved written or clinical examination
exams.jurisdiction: state board or Board-approved regional or national independent third-party clinical examinations
exams.quote: that the applicant has passed a clinical licensing examination, the standard of which shall be determined by the Board

interval_years.quote: On or before the first day of January of each year, each dentist engaged in the practice of dentistry in North Carolina shall make application to the North Carolina State Board of Dental Examiners and receive from said Board, subject to the further provisions of this section and of this Article, a certificate of renewal of said license.

required.quote: All dentists licensed under G.S. 90-30 shall be required to attend Board-approved courses of study in subjects relating to dentistry.

available.quote: The North Carolina State Board of Dental Examiners may issue a license by credentials to an applicant who has been licensed to practice dentistry in any state or territory of the United States

requirements.value: Applicant must be licensed in good standing in another state, have required education and training, pass satisfactory examinations, and meet other Board requirements
requirements.quote: if the applicant produces satisfactory evidence to the Board that the applicant has the required education, training, and qualifications, is in good standing with the licensing jurisdiction, has passed satisfactory examinations of proficiency in the knowledge and practice of dentistry as determined by the Board, and meets all other requirements of this section and rules adopted by the Board

exists.quote: Said Board of Dental Examiners shall consist of six dentists who are licensed to practice dentistry in North Carolina, one dental hygienist who is licensed to practice dental hygiene in North Carolina and one person who shall be a citizen and resident of North Carolina

national_association.quote: accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall engage in the practice of dentistry in this State, or offer or attempt to do so, unless such person is the holder of a valid license or certificate of renewal of license duly issued by the North Carolina State Board of Dental Examiners.

credential_type.quote: No person shall engage in the practice of dentistry in this State, or offer or attempt to do so, unless such person is the holder of a valid license or certificate of renewal of license duly issued by the North Carolina State Board of Dental Examiners.

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall engage in the practice of dentistry in this State, or offer or attempt to do so, unless such person is the holder of a valid license

title_protection.quote: Uses, in connection with his name, any title or designation, such as "dentist," "dental surgeon," "doctor of dental surgery," "D.D.S.," "D.M.D.," or any other letters, words or descriptive matter which, in any manner, represents him as being a dentist able or qualified to do or perform any one or more of the acts or practices set forth in subdivisions (1) through (10) above

scope_protection.quote: A person shall be deemed to be practicing dentistry in this State who does, undertakes or attempts to do, or claims the ability to do any one or more of the following acts or things which, for the purposes of this Article, constitute the practice of dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in fraud, deceit or misrepresentation in obtaining or attempting to obtain a license or renewal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in any act or acts of fraud, deceit or misrepresentation in obtaining or attempting to obtain a license or the renewal thereof

disciplinary_grounds.description: Chronic or persistent user of intoxicants, drugs or narcotics impairing ability to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is a chronic or persistent user of intoxicants, drugs or narcotics to the extent that the same impairs his ability to practice dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of criminal provisions of the dental practice act or entered plea of guilty or nolo contendere
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of any of the criminal provisions of this Article or has entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to any charge or charges arising therefrom

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of felony or misdemeanor involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of or entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to any felony charge or to any misdemeanor charge involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of violation of state or federal narcotic or barbiturate law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of or entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to any charge of violation of any state or federal narcotic or barbiturate law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in act or practice violative of the dental practice act or board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in any act or practice violative of any of the provisions of this Article or violative of any of the rules and regulations promulgated and adopted by the Board, or has aided, abetted or assisted any other person or entity in the violation of the same

disciplinary_grounds.description: Mentally, emotionally, or physically unfit to practice or afflicted with disability dangerous to patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is mentally, emotionally, or physically unfit to practice dentistry or is afflicted with such a physical or mental disability as to be deemed dangerous to the health and welfare of his patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conducted in-person solicitation of professional patronage or employed person to conduct such solicitation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has conducted in-person solicitation of professional patronage or has employed or procured any person to conduct such solicitation by personal contact with potential patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitted use of name, diploma or license by another person in illegal practice or fraudulent licensure
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has permitted the use of his name, diploma or license by another person either in the illegal practice of dentistry or in attempting to fraudulently obtain a license to practice dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in immoral conduct discrediting the dental profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in such immoral conduct as to discredit the dental profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtained or collected or attempted to obtain or collect fee through fraud, misrepresentation, or deceit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has obtained or collected or attempted to obtain or collect any fee through fraud, misrepresentation, or deceit

disciplinary_grounds.description: Negligent in the practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been negligent in the practice of dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employed unlicensed person to perform acts that require licensure
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has employed a person not licensed in this State to do or perform any act or service, or has aided, abetted or assisted any such unlicensed person to do or perform any act or service which under this Article or under Article 16 of this Chapter, can lawfully be done or performed only by a dentist or a dental hygienist licensed in this State

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetent in the practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is incompetent in the practice of dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practiced fraud, deceit or misrepresentation upon public or individual to acquire or retain patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has practiced any fraud, deceit or misrepresentation upon the public or upon any individual in an effort to acquire or retain any patient or patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Made fraudulent or misleading statements about skill, knowledge, or method of treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has made fraudulent or misleading statements pertaining to his skill, knowledge, or method of treatment or practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committed fraudulent or misleading acts in practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has committed any fraudulent or misleading acts in the practice of dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Published or caused to be published untruthful, fraudulent, or misleading advertisement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has, directly or indirectly, published or caused to be published or disseminated any advertisement for professional patronage or business which is untruthful, fraudulent, misleading, or in any way inconsistent with rules and regulations issued by the Board of Dental Examiners governing the time, place, or manner of such advertisements

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committed act or acts constituting malpractice in practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has, in the practice of dentistry, committed an act or acts constituting malpractice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitted dental hygienist or assistant to violate the dental practice act or rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has permitted a dental hygienist or a dental assistant in his employ or under his supervision to do or perform any act or acts violative of this Article, or of Article 16 of this Chapter, or of the rules and regulations promulgated by the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Wrongfully, fraudulently, or falsely held self out as qualified specialist
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has wrongfully or fraudulently or falsely held himself out to be or represented himself to be qualified as a specialist in any branch of dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Persistently maintained unsanitary offices, practices, or techniques
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has persistently maintained, in the practice of dentistry, unsanitary offices, practices, or techniques

disciplinary_grounds.description: Menace to public health by reason of serious communicable disease
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is a menace to the public health by reason of having a serious communicable disease

disciplinary_grounds.description: Distributed or caused to be distributed intoxicant, drug or narcotic for unlawful purpose
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has distributed or caused to be distributed any intoxicant, drug or narcotic for any other than a lawful purpose

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in unprofessional conduct as defined by board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in any unprofessional conduct as the same may be, from time to time, defined by the rules and regulations of the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Allowed fee-splitting for use of teledentistry services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has allowed fee-splitting for the use of teledentistry services

disciplinary_grounds.description: Limited patient's right or ability to raise grievances or file complaints with oversight bodies
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has limited, in any way, a patient's right or ability to raise grievances or file complaints with any appropriate oversight body, including the North Carolina State Board of Dental Examiners, the North Carolina Department of Justice, Division of Medicaid Investigations, and the North Carolina Department of Health and Human Services, Division of Health Benefits, Office of Compliance and Program Integrity

definition_quote.value: A person shall be deemed to be practicing dentistry in this State who does, undertakes or attempts to do, or claims the ability to do any one or more of the following acts or things which, for the purposes of this Article, constitute the practice of dentistry
definition_quote.quote: A person shall be deemed to be practicing dentistry in this State who does, undertakes or attempts to do, or claims the ability to do any one or more of the following acts or things which, for the purposes of this Article, constitute the practice of dentistry

value: diagnosis and treatment of oral diseases and conditions
clinical practices in dental school curricula
methods_authorized.quote: Diagnoses, treats, operates, or prescribes for any disease, disorder, pain, deformity, injury, deficiency, defect, or other physical condition of the human teeth, gums, alveolar process, jaws, maxilla, mandible, or adjacent tissues or structures of the oral cavity; Removes stains, accretions or deposits from the human teeth; Extracts a human tooth or teeth; Performs any phase of any operation relative or incident to the replacement or restoration of all or a part of a human tooth or teeth

drug_authority.value: Dentists may prescribe medications as part of treatment of dental and oral diseases
drug_authority.quote: Diagnoses, treats, operates, or prescribes for any disease, disorder, pain, deformity, injury, deficiency, defect, or other physical condition of the human teeth, gums, alveolar process, jaws, maxilla, mandible, or adjacent tissues or structures of the oral cavity

sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: The North Carolina Board of Dental Examiners may establish by regulation reasonable education, training, and equipment standards for safe administration and monitoring of general anesthesia and enteral and parenteral sedation for outpatients in the dental setting. Regulatory standards may include a permit process for general anesthesia and enteral and parenteral sedation by dentists.

sedation_permit_onsite_inspection_requir.quote: The requirements of any permit process adopted under the authority of this section shall include provisions that will allow a dentist to qualify for continued use of enteral sedation, if he or she is licensed to practice dentistry in North Carolina and shows the Board that he or she has been utilizing enteral sedation in a competent manner for the five years preceding January 1, 2002, and his or her office facilities pass an on-site examination and inspection by qualified representatives of the Board.

value: supervision under standing order (for qualified hygienists with 3+ years experience)
dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: A dental hygienist may practice only under the supervision of one or more licensed dentists... A dental hygienist who has three years of experience in clinical dental hygiene or a minimum of 2,000 hours performing primarily prophylaxis or periodontal debridement under the supervision of a licensed dentist, who completes annual CPR certification, who completes six hours each year of Board-approved continuing education in medical emergencies in addition to the requirements of G.S. 90-225.1, and who is designated by the employing dentist as being capable of performing clinical hygiene procedures without the direct supervision of the dentist, may perform one or more dental hygiene functions as described in G.S. 90-221(a) under the direction of a dentist based on a written standing order

collaborative_agreement_max_hygienists_p.quote: A dentist in private practice may not employ more than two dental hygienists at one and the same time who are employed in clinical dental hygiene positions.

advanced_practice_permit_available.quote: A dental hygienist who has three years of experience in clinical dental hygiene or a minimum of 2,000 hours performing primarily prophylaxis or periodontal debridement under the supervision of a licensed dentist, who completes annual CPR certification, who completes six hours each year of Board-approved continuing education in medical emergencies in addition to the requirements of G.S. 90-225.1, and who is designated by the employing dentist as being capable of performing clinical hygiene procedures without the direct supervision of the dentist, may perform one or more dental hygiene functions as described in G.S. 90-221(a) under the direction of a dentist based on a written standing order

value: rural and community clinics operated by Board-approved nonprofits
rural and community clinics operated by federal, State, county, or local governments
other facilities identified by the Office of Rural Health and approved by the Board as serving dental access shortage areas
advanced_practice_eligible_patient_popul.quote: The services are performed in nursing homes; rest homes; long-term care facilities; schools; rural and community clinics operated by Board-approved nonprofits; rural and community clinics operated by federal, State, county, or local governments; federally qualified health centers; and any other facilities identified by the Office of Rural Health and approved by the Board as serving dental access shortage areas.

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: Any licensed dentist who employs or engages the services of any person, firm or corporation to construct or repair, extraorally, prosthetic dentures, bridges, orthodontic appliance, or other replacements, for a part of a tooth, a tooth or teeth, shall furnish such person, firm or corporation with a written work order on forms prescribed by the North Carolina State Board of Dental Examiners

teledentistry_authorized.quote: Practice of teledentistry. - The provision of dental services by use of any electronic or other digital means, as authorized in G.S. 90-29(b)(11) and provided for in subsection (b) of this section.

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: Programs required for dental hygienists licensed in this State to qualify to administer local anesthetics pursuant to G.S. 90-221(a) shall be taught using lecture and laboratory or clinical formats at the University of North Carolina Adams School of Dentistry, the East Carolina University School of Dental Medicine, or a dental hygiene program accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation (CODA)

hygienist_nitrous_oxide_certification_re.quote: A dental assistant, or dental hygienist who shows evidence of education and training in Nitrous Oxide - Oxygen Inhalant Conscious Sedation within a formal educational program may aid and assist a licensed dentist in the administration of Nitrous Oxide - Oxygen Inhalant Conscious Sedation.

cpr_certification_required_for_sedation.quote: A dental hygienist who has three years of experience in clinical dental hygiene or a minimum of 2,000 hours performing primarily prophylaxis or periodontal debridement under the supervision of a licensed dentist, who completes annual CPR certification
